title: pithecoctenium xanthophyllum
intro: Pithecoctenium xanthophyllum, commonly known as the Yellow Leaf, is a species of flowering plant in the family Apocynaceae. This plant has been traditionally used in folk medicine, offering various health benefits such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which can aid in the treatment of wounds, fever, and other health issues. The therapeutic actions of Pithecoctenium xanthophyllum include analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antiseptic effects, which can help in soothing pain, reducing inflammation, and preventing infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
